items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: Dave Bartholomew told me... he believed that when Fats recorded that song, him and Fats, they had part ways.

ctx.x: Okay. Fats Dominow recorded it. Dave Bartholomew told me, and I tell this to the world because it's just exactly how he told me. He said, either, first he said, he believed that when Fats recorded that song, him and Fats, they had part ways. They were mad with each other. So he didn't make that record with Fats. Then he told me, this is another time, he said, you know, Fats recorded it, but he wanted to take your name off. That's the way he wanted it. Now, this, I'm, you know, there's some things you have to…
And I had to think. You'd be credited on this album.
